sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS device_keys (device_pubkey TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_pubkey TEXT NOT NULL, label TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, revoked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
SELECT owner_pubkey AS pubkey FROM device_keys WHERE owner_pubkey = ?1 LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO device_keys (device_pubkey, owner_pubkey, label, created_at, revoked) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, 0) ON CONFLICT (device_pubkey) DO UPDATE SET owner_pubkey = excluded.owner_pubkey, label = excluded.label, created_at = excluded.created_at, revoked = 0
UPDATE device_keys SET revoked = 1 WHERE device_pubkey = ?1 AND owner_pubkey = ?2
